title: HEMO: Harness Self-Evolution for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.40023v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic operator design (AOD) has increasingly adopted large language models (LLMs) to generate problem-specific search and variation operators for multi-objective combinatorial optimization (MOCO). Yet most methods evolve the operators while leaving the process that discovers them fixed. This limits adaptation as new Pareto trade-offs and operator interactions change where and how the search should proceed. We introduce HEMO, which makes the AOD harness itself a self-evolving optimization target. HEMO maintains a persistent harness state and updates one module at a time, revising the logic that determines which experience to retrieve, which operators to improve, which parents to select, and how to formulate the orchestration of search steps. Downstream solution quality and runtime guide these updates, while a discounted UCB scheduler directs adaptation toward promising modules as their utility changes. A persistent memory filesystem

translated_title: HEMO：面向多目标组合优化的框架自进化方法
translated_abstract: 自动算子设计（AOD）已越来越多地采用大型语言模型（LLM）为多目标组合优化（MOCO）生成针对特定问题的搜索与变异算子。然而，大多数方法仅进化算子本身，而发现算子的过程却固定不变。这限制了系统的适应性，因为新的帕累托权衡和算子交互会改变搜索应当在哪里以及如何进行。我们提出了HEMO，它使AOD框架本身成为一个自进化的优化目标。HEMO维护一个持久的框架状态，每次更新一个模块，修订决定检索哪些经验、改进哪些算子、选择哪些父代以及如何编排搜索步骤的逻辑。下游的解质量和运行时间指导这些更新，同时一个折扣UCB调度器在模块效用发生变化时，将自适应调整引导至具有前景的模块。一个持久记忆文件系统（原文摘要在此处不完整）。
tldr: HEMO的核心创新在于让多目标组合优化中自动算子设计的框架本身成为自进化的优化目标，通过持久框架状态、逐模块更新和折扣UCB调度，依据解质量与运行时间动态调整经验检索、算子改进、父代选择及搜索编排逻辑。
en_tdlr: HEMO's key contribution is making the automatic operator design harness itself a self-evolving optimization target for multi-objective combinatorial optimization, leveraging a persistent harness state, one-module-at-a-time updates, and a discounted UCB scheduler to adapt experience retrieval, operator improvement, parent selection, and search orchestration based on downstream solution quality and runtime.
